name: uart-smoke
description:
UART RAW-STREAM pilot over the SHIPPED clients: virtual (--backend virtual) vs real (--backend serial --target <pty>). Proves virtual == real on byte content + order + exit code, AND that the banner and each command response are actually present (expect). Exercises the REAL Enter path: the console dispatches on CR (0x0d - what a terminal and probe's default --eol cr send). Covers bare CR, CRLF (collapsed to one dispatch), and bare LF (tolerated). NOTE: the runner captures stdout with universal newlines, so a device 
 reads back as 
 here; the byte-exact 
 is asserted at the model level in tests/test_conformance_uart.py. Baud garble is out of pty scope (no bit clock).

expect:
help
commands: help printenv echo <text>
boot>

printenv
bootcmd=run distro_bootcmd
baudrate=115200
ver=pilot-1
boot>

help
commands: help printenv echo <text>
boot>

printenv
bootcmd=run distro_bootcmd
baudrate=115200
ver=pilot-1
boot>
